tools.name: screen_point_at
tools.description:
Point at something on the screen the user is sharing with the call. Draws an arrow at a named control or a ring around measured bounds, with a short caption. Replaces whatever is currently drawn.

Prefer target for an arrow, using the control label: "color balance", "Send", "Search". A failed lookup returns accessibility names that may differ from visible labels. Retry with a returned name only when it identifies the intended control; do not invent internal names.

Use x/y/width/height for a region, an explicit request for a circle or ring, or a visual fallback when a named lookup fails. Measure tight bounds from a fresh image of the shared surface only when you can confidently identify the target. A failed accessibility lookup does not prevent drawing a clearly visible control. If the view is stale or the target is unclear, get a fresh view or ask the user to clarify; do not invent coordinates.

Requires the user to be sharing their screen. If nothing is shared, ask them to share before pointing again. Confirm a mark only after the tool reports success.

marks.description: What to point at now, replacing whatever is on screen. Point at one thing at a time unless a step genuinely needs more.

items.description: One thing to point at: target naming a control for an arrow, or all four bounds measured from a fresh shared image for a ring. Use bounds for regions, explicit circle requests, or a clearly identified visual fallback after a name lookup fails. Supply either target or bounds, never both.

oneOf.description: A control, named and found on the surface. An arrow lands on it.
A region or clearly identified control, measured from a fresh shared image. Draws a ring; all four bounds are required.

target.description: The control's label, written the way the label itself is written: "color balance", "Send". Looked up on the surface, so the arrow lands on it.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the shared surface's width (0 to 1), measured from a fresh image.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the shared surface's height (0 to 1), measured from a fresh image.

width.description: Width, as a fraction of the surface's width.

height.description: Height, as a fraction of the surface's height.

caption.description: A short imperative for what to do with it, e.g. "Click Share". Say the rest out loud.

target_client_id.description: ID of the specific client to target. Required when multiple clients support host_cu; omit when only one is connected.

tools.name: screen_clear_marks
tools.description: Take down whatever is drawn on the user's shared screen. Use it when the step is done, when the user has moved on, or when the conversation has left the screen behind. Marks come down on their own when the share ends or moves to another surface.

target_client_id.description: ID of the specific client to target. Required when multiple clients support host_cu; omit when only one is connected.
